title: Southern Soul Academy

services.name: Muay Thai
services.desc: Known as “The Art of Eight Limbs,” Muay Thai is a powerful and effective striking art from Thailand that uses punches, kicks, knees, and elbows. It’s a complete stand-up fighting system (striking, kickboxing, and more) that builds strength, coordination, endurance, and confidence - and we’re bringing it straight to Navarre and Mary Esther. At Southern Soul Academy, we’re proud to bring Muay Thai to our Navarre/Mary Esther community, taught by Daniel Dorrough, a skilled fighter out of Top Tier Muay Thai. Daniel brings years of experience and a passion for helping students sharpen their skills in a safe, supportive, and high-energy environment. This Muay Thai system is perfect for beginners

services.name: Reserve Your Class
services.desc: Southern Soul Academy is a family-focused gym under the Renzo Gracie Affiliation, serving Mary Esther, Navarre, Fort Walton Beach, Gulf Breeze, and the surrounding Emerald Coast. We pride ourselves on creating a supportive and inclusive environment for practitioners of all ages and skill levels. With our experienced instructors expertise and dedication, you can trust that you’ll receive top-notch coaching and guidance to help you achieve your goals, whether it be improving your skills or advancing through ranks.
